description.html: The 30 cm Nomoy Pet tweezers are made of stainless steel and designed for feeding reptiles and working in larger terrariums. The packaging is marked model NZ-03/04, and the picture shows the curved-tip version, which makes it easier to reach food and terrarium corners.

Longer tweezers keep your hand further from the animal, which matters with species that have a strong grab reflex, such as bearded dragons and larger geckos, and when feeding snakes thawed prey. They also make work in tall and deep terrariums easier.

Offer the food calmly in front of the animal and let it take the bite itself; do not push the tweezers towards its head. You can also use them to remove leftovers and droppings, or rearrange decor without taking the animal out.

After feeding, wash the tweezers with warm water and detergent, and disinfect them after handling raw prey. For smaller terrariums and smaller species we also stock the 20 cm Nomoy Pet tweezers. See other accessories in our equipment range.
To order, contact us by phone or WhatsApp. We deliver to all towns in Serbia. In-person pickup is available in Novi Sad.
